verdict.rationale: Composio publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.composio.dev/openapi.json and docs with copy-paste code snippets (e.g. sessions.create, mcp.create). Its CLI lets users inspect schemas and execute tools from the terminal. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser API reference where examples can be run. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference UI, in-page runnable 'try it' examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
